about.title: About Our Group
about.subtitle: We are passionate about bringing people together through the joy of board games
about.description: Our group was founded with a simple mission: to create a welcoming community where board game enthusiasts can gather, play, and share their love for strategic tabletop games. We believe that board games have the power to bring people together, foster creativity, and create lasting friendships.
about.missionText: To promote the joy of board gaming and create an inclusive community for players of all skill levels.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Discover the journey that brought us together and the passion that drives our community

story.title: How It All Began
story.subtitle: The story behind our board games community
story.paragraph1: In 2018, a small group of friends gathered around a table with a simple goal: to share their love for board games and create meaningful connections. What started as a casual meetup in a local café has grown into a thriving community of over 200 passionate players.
story.paragraph2: Our founders, Sarah and Michael, were inspired by the way board games brought people together, breaking down barriers and creating unforgettable moments. They believed that everyone deserves a place where they can feel welcome, learn new strategies, and make lasting friendships.
story.paragraph3: Today, our community continues to grow, hosting regular events, tournaments, and casual game nights. We've expanded to multiple locations and have become a recognized hub for board game enthusiasts in the region.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To create an inclusive and welcoming environment where people of all backgrounds can discover the joy of board games, develop strategic thinking, and build meaningful relationships through shared experiences.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the leading board games community that inspires creativity, fosters learning, and brings people together through the universal language of play and strategy.

values.title: Our Values
list: Inclusivity - Everyone is welcome regardless of experience level
Learning - We believe in continuous growth and skill development
Community - Building lasting friendships through shared experiences
Fun - Creating enjoyable and memorable gaming experiences
Respect - Treating everyone with kindness and consideration
